currentRelease.title: ChimpMaera — Public Truth and Discoverability Increment

policy.latest: The newest accepted regular product increment is draft=false, prerelease=false and must resolve from GitHub /releases/latest after publication.
policy.draft: Draft releases are preparation only and must never be described as public or current.
policy.prerelease: Prereleases are optional preview artifacts and must never be described as regular Latest.

claimEvidence.claim: v0.2.0-poc.20260803.2 is the current regular Latest release.
nonClaims: A tag or draft alone is not public release evidence.
Calendar cadence does not determine release status.

claimEvidence.claim: The increment contains governed validation for local synthetic company data.
nonClaims: No universal ETL, MDM or system-of-record capability is claimed.

claimEvidence.claim: Published release assets are bound to an explicit manifest, byte sizes and SHA-256 digests.
nonClaims: Repository tests do not replace anonymous public asset readback.
Release metadata edits do not authorize tag or asset replacement.

claimEvidence.claim: The public first screen identifies the current local proof of concept, separates broader direction from shipped maturity, and routes readers to capabilities, evidence and limitations.
nonClaims: No search-ranking or adoption improvement is claimed.
Knowledge Operating System remains direction, not current product maturity.
Documentation does not prove production readiness or live-system compatibility.

claimEvidence.claim: ChimpMaera ships a deterministic Verification Fabric contract that binds plans, checks, evidence, verdicts and last-known-good readback so users can audit why a local synthetic verification passed or failed.
claimEvidence.userValue: Users get one stable, digest-bound vocabulary for verification evidence instead of disconnected success assertions.

functionalProof.result: PASS: valid contract bundles verify with canonical SHA-256 bindings.

safetyProof.result: PASS: changed-surface stale, missing, mismatched, self-produced and corrupted evidence fails closed.

nonClaims: Local deterministic synthetic proof only; no deployment, profile-specific runtime validation, production readiness or external authority is proven.

claimEvidence.claim: ChimpMaera ships check-only Update/Doctor contracts and read-only diagnostics that make compatibility and repair readiness inspectable without applying an update.
claimEvidence.userValue: Operators can receive typed, reproducible diagnostics and receipts before any state-changing maintenance is considered.

functionalProof.result: PASS: current focused Update/Doctor suites verify valid check-only bundles, core diagnostics and composed projections.

safetyProof.result: PASS: unsupported versions, mutable targets, digest drift and authority deltas are denied with typed fail-closed results.

nonClaims: Local deterministic synthetic proof only; no update application, repair, migration, Docker/cloud observation, deployment or production readiness is proven.

claimEvidence.claim: ChimpMaera ships an authority-free HMI/Harness multitool contract for bounded generation, disclosure-safe discovery and evidence-grounded explanation payloads.
claimEvidence.userValue: Users can inspect supported operations and explanations through stable payloads without the interface silently gaining execution rights.

functionalProof.result: PASS 31/31: current focused HMI suites cover generation, adapter parity, disclosure, discovery, explanation and post-explain consistency.

safetyProof.result: PASS: changed-surface disclosure, authority-delta and cross-contract inconsistency probes fail closed.

nonClaims: Local deterministic synthetic proof only; no runtime execution authority, generic operation dispatcher, live provider integration or production UI is proven.

claimEvidence.claim: ChimpMaera ships a closed Microsoft Entra delegated identity profile that describes single-tenant Authorization Code plus PKCE authentication without granting product authority.
claimEvidence.userValue: Integrators get an auditable identity boundary with fixed issuer, audience, tenant and delegated-scope expectations before any live tenant setup.

functionalProof.result: PASS 4/4: the synthetic delegated single-tenant profile verifies with canonical digest stability.

safetyProof.result: PASS: broad/application permissions, tenant substitution, unsafe credentials and authority-bearing variants are denied.

nonClaims: Local deterministic synthetic proof only; no live Microsoft Entra tenant, registration, consent, OBO flow, token validation, Conditional Access, DLP or production compatibility is proven.

claimEvidence.claim: ChimpMaera ships a closed authority-free Power Platform read connector contract with five bounded operations, required readback and receipt binding.
claimEvidence.userValue: Integrators can evaluate a precise read-only connector surface without generic invocation, write targets or false-success shortcuts.

functionalProof.result: PASS 4/4: the five-operation synthetic read connector verifies with identity and Verification Fabric bindings.

safetyProof.result: PASS: open targets, broad scopes, mutation escape, generic invocation, optional readback, false success and credentials are denied.

nonClaims: Local deterministic synthetic proof only; no live Power Platform import, tenant compatibility, Entra consent, OBO, DLP, Gateway integration, certification or production behavior is proven.
